title: What Grace is Mine
lyrics_original: What grace is mine, that He who dwells in endless light
Called through the night to find my distant soul.
And from His scars poured mercy that would plead for me
That I might live and in His Name be known.
So I will go wherever He is calling me;
I lose my life to find my life in Him.
I give my all to gain the hope that never dies;
I bow my heart, take up my cross, and follow Him.
What grace is mine, to know His breath alive in me;
beneath His wings my weary soul may soar.
All fear can flee for death's dark night is overcome;
My Savior lives and reigns forever more.
So I will go where ever He is calling me;
I lose my life to find my life in Him.
I give my all to gain the hope that never dies;
I bow my heart, take up my cross, and follow Him.

bible_verses.english: but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ. Yes, most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for reaching out into my darkness and calling me Your own through the incredible mercy of Jesus. I freely yield my life, my plans, and my heart to You today. Give me the courage to take up my cross and follow wherever You lead, knowing that losing my life for Your sake is where true life begins. May my weary soul find its rest beneath the shadow of Your wings. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: It is an astonishing truth that the God of endless light reached into our darkness to call us by name. His mercy, poured out through His wounds, doesn't just rescue us—it transforms our entire purpose. When we surrender our lives and take up our cross, we don't lose anything of true value; instead, we gain the indestructible hope of Christ. Today, let His graceful presence carry your weary heart as you walk faithfully wherever He leads.
